triage-a-support-inbox.input:
Please fix the wrong amount on my invoice.
Just saying thanks, no reply needed.
Order never arrived and the party is tonight.
Do you ship to Canada?

forms.name: inbox-form.json

steps.name: 01-inbox
steps.command:
thinkthen filter 'Does this need a reply?' --lines < inbox.txt \
    | thinkthen annotate inbox-form.json --lines --details \
    | jq -r '"\(.value.kind) \(.value.urgency)  \(.input)"'
steps.output:
billing 0.58  Please fix the wrong amount on my invoice.
delivery 1.96  Order never arrived and the party is tonight.
question 0.01  Do you ship to Canada?

screen-studies-for-a-review.input:
Survey of 900 remote workers: output rose 4%.
Opinion essay on open-plan offices.
Abstract only: we studied remote work. No methods or results.
Title only: Remote work and output.

steps.name: 03-studies
steps.command:
thinkthen decide 'Does this report measured results on remote work?' \
      --lines --threshold 0.1:0.9 --details < studies.txt \
    | jq -r '"\(.value)  \(.input)"'
steps.output:
true  Survey of 900 remote workers: output rose 4%.
false  Opinion essay on open-plan offices.
null  Abstract only: we studied remote work. No methods or results.
null  Title only: Remote work and output.

code-open-ended-survey-answers.input:
Too expensive for what it does.
The app crashes when I upload a file.
Reports take a full minute to load.
Everything works and the reports are quick.

steps.name: 04-answers
steps.command:
thinkthen score 'How happy is this answer?' \
      'Unhappy.' 'Neutral.' 'Happy.' --lines --details < answers.txt \
    | jq -r 'select(.value < 1) | .input' \
    | thinkthen tag 'What is wrong here?' price speed bugs --lines --details \
    | jq -r '"\(.value | join(","))  \(.input)"'
steps.output:
price  Too expensive for what it does.
bugs  The app crashes when I upload a file.
speed  Reports take a full minute to load.

join-two-tables-by-meaning.input:
Card charges fail at checkout.
Export finished hours late again.

steps.name: 05-join
steps.command:
thinkthen decide 'Do these two describe the same problem?' --lines \
      --details < pairs.txt | jq -r 'select(.value) | .input'
steps.output:
Card charges fail at checkout. / INC-1 payment gateway returns 500
Export finished hours late again. / INC-2 nightly export queue backed up

group-alerts-into-incidents.input:
INC-1 checkout returns 500 at payment
INC-2 search results load slowly
INC-3 nightly export ran late

steps.name: 06-alert
steps.command:
hit=$(thinkthen find --none "Which incident covers: $alert" \
      < incidents-open.txt) && echo "$hit" &&
    echo "$hit" | thinkthen decide "Is this the same failure as: $alert"
steps.output:
INC-1 checkout returns 500 at payment
true

rank-the-inbound-leads.input:
We need 200 seats next quarter. Please send a quote.
Please remove me from this list.
Our team of six wants to buy today. How do we pay?
Loved your talk at the conference last week.

steps.name: 07-leads
steps.command:
thinkthen filter 'Is this a buying inquiry?' --lines < leads.txt \
    | thinkthen rank 'Is this buyer ready to pay now?' --lines \
    | thinkthen choose 'Which team should take this?' enterprise smb --lines \
    | jq -r '"\(.value)  \(.input)"'
steps.output:
smb  Our team of six wants to buy today. How do we pay?
enterprise  We need 200 seats next quarter. Please send a quote.

screen-a-post-before-it-goes-up.input: The author is an idiot and this take is lazy.

steps.name: 08-insult
steps.command: thinkthen decide 'Does this post insult someone?' < post.txt

steps.name: 08-spam
steps.command: thinkthen decide 'Is this post spam?' --threshold 0.8 < post.txt

steps.name: 08-topic
steps.command:
thinkthen decide 'Is this post off topic for a reply to an article?' \
      --threshold 0.8 < post.txt

check-an-expense-against-the-policy.input:
Meals with a client: up to $75 a head.
Flights: economy only, booked 14 days out.
Software: needs a manager's approval.

steps.name: 09-expense
steps.command:
thinkthen find "Which rule covers: $expense" < policy.txt \
    | thinkthen decide "Does this rule allow: $expense" --lines --details \
    | jq -r '"\(.input)  \(.value)"'
steps.output: Meals with a client: up to $75 a head.  true

split-a-scanned-packet-into-documents.input:
Invoice 7 for Northwind. Page 1 of 2.
Invoice 7 for Northwind. Page 2 of 2. Total due $1,200.
Invoice 8 for Contoso. Page 1 of 1. Total due $310.
Notice to all customers. Page 1 of 1. New terms from May 1.

steps.name: 11-kinds
steps.command:
thinkthen choose 'What kind of page is this?' invoice notice \
      --lines --raw < pages.txt | paste -sd' ' -

steps.name: 11-gaps
steps.command:
awk 'NR>1 {print p" | "$0} {p=$0}' pages.txt \
    | thinkthen decide 'Are the two sides from different documents?' \
        --lines | jq -r .value | paste -sd' ' -
